profile.summary: Anthony Gauthier is a mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Axios, a popular HTTP client library used across both frontend and backend environments. His contributions demonstrate strong skills in API design, modular JavaScript development, and robust error handling. While his contributions are focused on Axios (a backend-friendly library), they indirectly benefit frontend applications using Axios. Anthony shows proficiency in modern JavaScript practices including ES6+ features, functional programming patterns, and defensive programming techniques. His work highlights a focus on clean, maintainable code with minimal complexity and attention to edge cases. There is no evidence of frontend framework experience (React, Vue, etc.) or TypeScript usage in his contributions.
